login.title: Sign in
login.magicLinkSent: Check your inbox: we sent you a sign-in link.
login.signUpSent: Check your inbox to confirm your email address.
login.invitedBy: You were invited by {{name}}. Sign in or create an account to continue.
login.alreadyRegistered: An account with this email address already exists. Sign in, or use a different email address.
login.invalidCredentials: Email address or password is incorrect.
login.emailNotConfirmed: Your email address is not confirmed yet. Click the link in the email we sent you.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts or emails in a short time. Please try again within an hour.
login.linkExpired: This email link has expired or was already used. Just sign in, or request a new sign-in link.
login.linkError: Something went wrong with the link from your email. Please try signing in again.

credits.title: Credits and licenses
credits.intro: KineAid uses exercises from open databases. Thanks to all creators and contributors!
credits.kineaid: Own set of rehabilitation exercises, written for KineAid.
credits.fedb: Open exercise database in JSON format with photos, released into the public domain.
credits.wger: Open source fitness app and exercise database. Texts and images are under Creative Commons licenses; the author and license are shown with each exercise.
credits.custom: Exercises your physiotherapist adds remain the property of the physiotherapist.
credits.disclaimer: KineAid does not replace professional advice. Only do exercises as prescribed by your physiotherapist and stop if it hurts.
